audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and First item were rendered as Skill/Shen/Shen/Shen while the whys under them describe Quinn winning each of those stages, and the packet chart puts Quinn on all six lane rows.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Quinn x6, Skill] and Quinn wins 58.47% over 366 games. whys[1] 'you stack Harrier procs faster', whys[2] 'Q-blind into E-Vault all-in', whys[3] 'your kite range beats his taunt range', whys[5] 'still out-damages a Shen who only has armor' all read as Quinn wins.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped to Quinn in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings raised to match. Row 6 left on Shen because whys[6], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all say he reclaims it — that is a deliberate divergence from the packet's 'Skill'.

audit.why: Quinn levels 1-3, level 6 as a roam window while Shen's R is a map tool rather than a duel button, first-item lethality, Shen at 2+ items — all present and correctly ordered. Stand United's 200/180/160s cooldown now anchors the R advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks BASIC ATTACKS only — Blinding Assault and Vault's damage pass straight through it, so 'fight his W block' was advice with no mechanism. And Stand United is a channel while Vault explicitly interrupts, so Vaulting onto a channelling Shen cancels the rescue.
audit.why: Riot text for W: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Riot text for Quinn's E: 'she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it.' Shen's R carries the channel flag. The missing-interactions file separately flags that Shadow Dash's taunt cancels Behind Enemy Lines.
audit.corrected: W scoped to basic attacks, the Vault-interrupt on Stand United stated, and the taunt-cancels-your-R interaction added to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers and no resource note.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and costs 150 energy — after using it he is often energy-starved, which is the real punish window. Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Both numbers and the energy cost now stated.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shadow Dash (E): 18s at rank 1 and 150 energy — his only engage, and the taunt cancels Behind Enemy Lines. - Spirit's Refuge (W, 16s) blocks basic attacks only, so poke through it with Q.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks autos, not Blinding Assault. Vault interrupts, so it can cancel Stand United.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge eats basic attacks — Q through it, auto after.

edits.before: Vaulting INTO the fight to feel like an assassin — Vault is your spacing reset, not an engage.
edits.after: Stand United is a 200s channel — Vault into him as it starts and the whole rescue is cancelled.

notes: Row 6 deliberately kept on Shen against the packet's 'Skill', because three separate content fields (whys[6], spikes[3], late) describe him reclaiming the game and flipping only the chart would have created the exact two-answers-on-one-page problem. If the mirror (shen__quinn) lands on Skill there, mirror-fix will settle it. Packet games (366) disagrees with the brief's top-level games (678).
